workstreams.label: Customer-record reconciliation
workstreams.brief: Work only on data reconciliation. Inspect all CSVs under /workspace/workstreams/migration/sources, reconcile schemas, deduplicate orders, quantify the dataset, and surface genuine customer-record conflicts with lineage. Write /workspace/results/migration/master.csv, summary.md, conflicts.json, conflict_review.csv, and final.json. Do not invent source precedence or silently publish disputed values.

workstreams.label: Batch-export implementation
workstreams.brief: Work only on the export utility. Inspect /workspace/workstreams/export/customer_export, implement and test export_batch while preserving the single-record API, deterministic paths, retry safety, and auditable mixed-batch reporting. Write the completed package under /workspace/results/export/customer_export plus /workspace/results/export/test_report.md and final.json. Keep the unresolved product semantics explicit for parent integration.
